claim: Reverse selected agent files without changing other files in the checkpoint.
where: landing page and demo recovery action
sandbox: fresh browser demo; select two of four files; assert only those files are marked reversed

claim: Export selected changes as a patch without running it.
where: landing page, desktop ledger action, and README
sandbox: native fixtures with newline-terminated and missing-final-newline text; export both selected files, assert markers, dry-run GNU patch, and reject a binary selection

claim: Demo sample data is separate, resettable, and removed when you leave.
where: demo banner, landing page, privacy policy, README
sandbox: fresh browser demo; mutate sample; reset and exit; assert only demo-prefixed storage is removed

claim: The demo works offline after one visit.
sandbox: fresh browser demo; wait for service worker; go offline; reload the sample ledger

claim: An issued Sociobot license restores Pro on this device, and an unpublished checkout is not shown as a purchase action.
where: landing Pro section, terms, and license restore form
sandbox: fresh landing with a mocked unpublished Sociobot catalog; restore an issued license and assert active Pro status with no purchase link

claim: The app verifies a saved Sociobot license no more than once each day.
sandbox: fresh landing with a mocked valid license; reload after the first verification and assert only one verification request

claim: Project contents stay on this device.
sandbox: native fixture; capture unique chosen-folder data beside a sentinel and assert no outside or local network access

claim: Project snapshots and manifests are encrypted locally with a ledger passphrase that is not stored.
where: landing facts, desktop capture form, privacy policy, README
sandbox: native fixture; capture a unique secret; inspect every ledger file for its absence; reopen the encrypted snapshot with the passphrase

claim: Retention settings are encrypted in the local ledger.
sandbox: native fixture; create a ledger with a retention setting, assert settings.enc has encrypted storage bytes and no retention field, then reopen the value with the passphrase

claim: You can choose how many recent checkpoints to keep, and old checkpoints are pruned without breaking boundary recovery.
sandbox: native fixture; retain two checkpoints, create three, and reverse the oldest retained change using its encrypted baseline

claim: Pro stores a team policy note inside the encrypted local ledger.
where: landing pricing section, desktop capture form, terms, README
sandbox: native Pro fixture; save a policy note and assert it reopens through encryption but is absent from raw settings bytes

claim: Pro exports a password-protected recovery file.
where: landing pricing section, desktop ledger actions, terms, README
sandbox: native fixture; encrypt a patch and assert its unique plaintext is absent from the recovery bytes

claim: Opening a password-protected recovery produces a patch for review without running it.
sandbox: native fixture; decrypt a recovery with its passphrase and assert a wrong passphrase is rejected

claim: Records only the project folder you choose.
sandbox: native fixture; capture a chosen folder beside an outside sentinel, replace a selected parent with a symlink, attempt reversal, and assert the sentinel is unchanged

claim: Skips files over 2 MB.
sandbox: native fixture; capture a small file and a 2 MB-plus file, then assert only the small file is recorded

claim: Git metadata is excluded from checkpoints.
sandbox: native fixture; capture a project with .git metadata and assert the metadata is absent from the recorded files

claim: The app skips .git, node_modules, target, and dist folders.
sandbox: native fixture with all four folders and a project file; assert only project file is captured

claim: Each checkpoint shows the request, commands, files, and check result.
sandbox: native fixture; capture a changed file and assert each recorded field

claim: The app compares each checkpoint with the previous checkpoint.
sandbox: native fixture; make three captures and assert each delta uses the prior snapshot

claim: Creates a safety checkpoint before a selected-file reversal.
where: landing page, demo recovery dialog, README
sandbox: native fixture; reverse one changed file and then restore it from the safety checkpoint without touching an unrelated file

claim: Deletes local checkpoint snapshots without changing project files.
sandbox: native fixture; delete a ledger store and assert its project sentinel remains

claim: The desktop app loads a bundled sample project without accessing a real folder.
sandbox: native fixture; load and reset bundled sample beside real sentinel; reverse a sample file; assert sentinel is unchanged

claim: The landing page offers only a complete release matching its own version for your operating system.
sandbox: mock GitHub latest-release API under Linux, macOS, and Windows user agents; assert each exact current-version asset link, then assert an older release falls back to the release page

claim: The release workflow validates the exact tag, desktop files, SHA256SUMS, and latest.json before it passes.
sandbox: complete release fixture with all platform assets and matching checksums passes the workflow validator; a stale tag fixture fails

claim: Before a visitor starts checkout, the landing page asks only GitHub for release files and Sociobot for product publication.
sandbox: fresh landing page with mocked complete release and published Pro catalog; record requests and assert only same-origin, GitHub, and Sociobot

claim: The Linux installer verifies and installs an executable app.
sandbox: mock release; assert checksum verification, stable executable installation, and launch

claim: The Windows installer verifies a release checksum before starting the installer.
sandbox: static installer contract; assert Get-FileHash comparison occurs before Start-Process

claim: macOS builds are unsigned during this release phase.
sandbox: release workflow fixture; assert the macOS build has no signing certificate or notarization step

claim: The release workflow builds desktop packages on macOS, Windows, and Linux runners.
sandbox: workflow fixture; assert required runner matrix and release artifact manifest steps
